name: Ai Ai
source:
Every ordinary day we live may be a miracle happening in succession.Play as "Liu Jie" with occupational quirks, spending abstract yet mundane days with partners in the metropolitan hustle. Finally, navigate through your own crossroads...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3160030]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们生活的每一个平凡的日子都可能是一个接连发生的奇迹。扮演有着职业怪癖的“刘杰”，与伙伴们在都市的喧嚣中度过抽象而又平凡的日子。最后，穿过你自己的十字路口……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3160030]Steam[/url]]
